science: Root read actual public apparatus, starter, oracle, independent lab-coordinate reference, tests, validator and AUTHOR. Independently derived normalized lab snapshot weight 1+beta*p_x/E using momentum Jacobian and homogeneous worldline selection; checked stress-energy/particle-current moment formula and both boost signs. Source integrates the correct rest measure and transforms four-momenta exactly, but samples rest-frame labels rather than the defined laboratory spatial snapshot. Independent lab integral and microscopic worldline calculation validate the changed ensemble.
public_input_review: Canonical d3p rest measure, comoving temperature, number-conserving ideal gas, equal per-particle lab-simultaneous fixed-volume detector and analysis-only frame transformation uniquely specify the measurement. These are necessary apparatus definitions. Neutral full-replacement instruction; no missing weight, calibration identity, private mass, hidden preparation or prescribed solver is supplied. Public image is explicitly limited to environment files.
calibration_review: 264 fixed-sigma readings at22 controls: nonzero gas boost with matched analysis frame plus zero gas boost with independently varied analysis speed. Both models coincide for every mass. Positive rest-energy mass derivative proves identification; full mass scan confirms it. Sigma=.004 is independent of signal and mass.
grading_review: Standard .04 normalized RMS gate. All256 noisy fits pass calibration and parameter checks, oracle worst .000294 and source minimum .149763. Independent54domain corners agree below8.38e-14; reference refinement below1.08e-14. Local oracle7/7; completed source4pass and3intended hidden failures. Both controls finish below1second. Numeric output grading does not inspect implementation.
classification_caveat: Retaining the correctly boosted rest-label ensemble is physical sampling failure. Identifying correct lab measure but introducing boost, Jacobian, normalization or numerical error must be classified separately.

primary_background.scope: Root inspected Appendix C.6-C.7, which distinguishes the two simultaneous-slice means; task formula independently derived.
